blindReviewDeclaration: Fresh v2s-rooted review reopened the complete input checklist, all kernels and routed memory hits, corpus entries G-01/G-03/G-05/G-06/G-10, current RM1 and upstream R5 sources before reading round 1. It independently attempted to falsify all five claimed closures; round-1 material was read only after that source-first verdict work.
expectedBehavior: P3-B consumes only the dynamically derived post-R-24 operation inventory and exact delta, never a hand-written write count.
Every package-exit denominator binds its actual owning source; D1 is the complete routed-memory hit set and D5 includes the accepted Journey and interaction sources for UI units.
R-24 receipt acquisition, duplicate-key recovery, request-hash comparison, FK translation and hidden-reference projection remain one REQUIRED command protocol.
P4 derives a canonical call-path ledger from fixed roots, identity, classifications and exclusions before consumers optimize it.
P6/P3-D remain blocked until required interaction artifacts are accepted, hash-bound into the affected design/manifest unit, and reviewed in the newly triggered allowed cycle.

closureAssessments.evidence: Plan §1.3 requires a generated post-P3-B snapshot and exact delta, but P3-B exit still states `20 个业务写 endpoint`.
P3-B now specifies REQUIRED receipt acquisition, insert-race re-read/hash handling, terminal receipt behavior, FK/reference protection, typed conversion and concurrent red fixtures.

D1 binds only incremental-compliance-hook.md although plan §2 defines D1 as every routed project-memory hit; the checker accepts any non-empty sourcePath/selector. UI D5 also omits accepted Journey/interaction sources.
P4-A now fixes roots, query-boundary identity, classifications, constrained exclusions, ledger schema and production-path insertion red proof.
Plan §7.1 gives RM1-IA-01 through RM1-IA-03, block conditions, required artifact contents, Dexter acceptance, path/hash/unique-anchor re-freeze and follow-up review.

findings.title: P3-B still hard-codes an incompatible 20-write exit denominator
findings.evidence: Plan §1.3 requires the generated post-P3-B snapshot and exact delta, while RM1-P3-B exit still requires `20 个业务写 endpoint`.
findings.risk: The post-R-24 PUT retirement plus POST/DELETE additions can be falsely closed against an obsolete count rather than one exact inventory and owner binding.
findings.disposition: Keep NO_GO. Replace the P3-B fixed-count exit with the post-snapshot exact set and bind each changed entry to P3-A template, P3-B delta ownership and its red fixture.

findings.title: Six denominator fields are not yet bound to all real owning sources
findings.evidence: Manifest D1 sourcePath is only project-memory/decisions/incremental-compliance-hook.md, contrary to plan §2 D1 `project-memory 路由命中原文`; validator validateUnitSourceCompliance accepts any non-empty path/selector. U09/U10 D5 names only frontend-asset-carryover-manifest.json although plan §2 requires accepted Journey/interaction sources.
findings.risk: A package can mechanically pass while omitting a routed assertion or the approved user/interaction source that governs its changed surface.
findings.disposition: Keep NO_GO. Declare and mechanically validate the complete D1 routed-hit denominator and D5 UI owning-source set per applicable unit, with wrong-owning-source red mutations before a successor review cycle.

solutionReasonableness.problemFit: RM1 remains a proportionate remediation design: preserving a single deployable and serial package exits is preferable to adding infrastructure or new business scope.
solutionReasonableness.simplerAlternativeAssessment: The smallest safe repair is to make the already-chosen dynamic inventory and six-source contract exact; a parallel governance framework or generic workflow engine is unnecessary.
solutionReasonableness.costFit: Two source-level design corrections are low-cost relative to permitting an obsolete operation count and self-referential source denominators into implementation.

conclusion.summary: M=2, S=0, N=0. M-002, S-001 and S-002 are closed by the current design, but M-001 and M-003 remain independently confirmed; all RM1-U01 through RM1-U11 therefore remain NO_GO.
conclusion.authorizationBoundary: This round-2 DESIGN verdict is final for this cycle and grants no implementation, contract, migration, test, script, runtime, seed/reset, dynamic-environment or Roadmap-current-state authority. A future fix requires the governing remediation process and a new review cycle only when its trigger is authorized.
